name: cat-large-file
upstream_reason: Plain cat on large file — should block

name: cat-small-file
upstream_reason: Small file — not worth delegating

name: cat-with-flag
upstream_reason: cat with -n flag — should still block

name: head-large-file
upstream_reason: head on large file — should block

name: head-with-count
upstream_reason: head -100 — still a bulk read, block

name: tail-large-file
upstream_reason: tail on large file — should block

name: less-large-file
upstream_reason: less on large file — should block

name: cat-pipe
upstream_reason: Piped command — targeted read

name: cat-redirect
upstream_reason: Redirect — copying file, not reading into context

name: non-read-command
upstream_reason: Not a file read command

name: grep-command
upstream_reason: grep is a targeted search — not caught

name: cat-quoted-path
upstream_reason: Quoted path — should still be caught

name: cat-nonexistent
upstream_reason: File doesn't exist — let Bash handle the error

name: empty-command
upstream_reason: Empty command — pass through

name: missing-command-field
upstream_reason: No command field — pass through

name: more-large-file
upstream_reason: more on large file — only regex-matched command without coverage

name: head-n-space-count
upstream_reason: Parser bug: -n and 5 are separate args, 5 is treated as file path — file '5' won't exist so allow

name: cat-quoted-path-with-space
upstream_reason: Quoted path containing a space — word-split-on-space parsing must not break this into two bogus tokens and fall through to allow

name: cat-complex-code-over-threshold
upstream_reason: Fidelity axis: real 405-line file with race-sensitive lock/retry/circuit-breaker logic in its sampled head. A cheap worker's summary would flatten exactly the details (lock ordering, half-open probe exclusivity) that make this code correct, so the gate should keep it in context even past the line threshold.

name: cat-simple-log-over-threshold
upstream_reason: Fidelity axis: real 400-line access log, one repetitive record shape per line. A worker's summary loses nothing a human or Claude would act on, so once the cost axis clears the threshold this should delegate.

name: head-complex-code-small-slice
upstream_reason: Cost axis: head -30 only ingests 30 lines regardless of the file's 405-line total, so this stays under threshold and allows on cost alone — independent of the file's complexity.

name: cat-simple-data-under-threshold
upstream_reason: Cost axis: real 60-line simple CSV export, well under the 350-line threshold — allowed regardless of the fidelity axis because the volume never clears the gate.

name: sh-c-wrapped-more-large
upstream_reason: Bypass seen in Codex after a block: the same read wrapped in /bin/sh -c must be judged as the inner read.

name: absolute-path-more-large
upstream_reason: Bypass seen in Codex after a block: an absolute path to the read command must match like the bare name.

name: zsh-lc-wrapped-cat-large
upstream_reason: Combined flags (-lc) still carry -c, so the wrapped read is unwrapped and gated.

name: sh-c-wrapped-cat-small
upstream_reason: Unwrapping must not change the verdict for a small file.

name: sh-c-wrapped-cat-piped-outside
upstream_reason: A pipe outside the wrapper is a targeted read, same as the unwrapped cat-pipe case.

name: sh-runs-script-file
upstream_reason: Without -c the shell runs the file as a script instead of printing it, so there is nothing to gate.

name: bash-O-option-wrapped-cat-large
upstream_reason: -O takes a separate shopt name; skipping it must still reach -c and gate the wrapped read.

name: bash-rcfile-wrapped-cat-large
upstream_reason: --rcfile takes a separate file argument; it must not be mistaken for the command or stop the unwrap before -c.

name: bash-sh-two-level-nested-cat-large
upstream_reason: Two nested wrappers with alternating quote styles unwrap to the inner read.

name: bash-sh-escaped-quote-cat-large
upstream_reason: Escaped quotes cannot be safely tokenized by xargs; the wrapper must fail closed instead of allowing the read.

name: cat-large-stderr-to-devnull
upstream_reason: Only stderr is redirected; the file's content still reaches context, so the read is gated like a plain cat.

name: cat-large-stderr-to-stdout
upstream_reason: 2>&1 merges stderr into stdout, which still reaches context.

name: cat-large-stdout-to-stderr
upstream_reason: Stdout sent to stderr still lands in the assistant's context; only a file target keeps it out.

name: cat-large-append-to-file
upstream_reason: Stdout appended to a file — copying, not reading into context.

name: cat-large-both-to-file
upstream_reason: Stdout and stderr both sent to a file — nothing reaches context.

name: sh-c-wrapped-cat-large-stderr-to-devnull
upstream_reason: A stderr-only redirect inside the wrapper does not keep the unwrapped read out of context.

name: cat-simple-log-exact-purpose
upstream_reason: A purpose is agent-supplied and cannot relax the gate for a bulk read of simple repetitive content; use a targeted range read for exact order and timestamps.

name: cat-simple-log-overview-purpose
upstream_reason: Purpose axis: an overview-level purpose survives a worker's summary, so the simple 400-line log is delegated as in case 20.

name: small-file
upstream_reason: File under threshold — delegation overhead not worth it

name: boundary-exact-350
upstream_reason: Exactly at threshold (<=350) — should not block

name: just-over-threshold
upstream_reason: One line over threshold — should block

name: large-file
upstream_reason: Well over threshold — clear delegation candidate

name: very-large-file
upstream_reason: Very large file — blocked regardless of extension

name: empty-file
upstream_reason: Empty file — nothing to delegate

name: targeted-read-offset
upstream_reason: Offset set — targeted read, allow through

name: targeted-read-limit
upstream_reason: Limit set — targeted read, allow through

name: targeted-read-both
upstream_reason: Both offset and limit — definitely a targeted read

name: nonexistent-file
upstream_reason: File doesn't exist — let Read handle the error

name: empty-filepath
upstream_reason: Empty path — pass through

name: missing-filepath-field
upstream_reason: No file_path field — pass through gracefully

name: offset-zero
upstream_reason: offset:0 treated as targeted — known bypass, documenting behavior

name: limit-zero
upstream_reason: limit:0 treated as targeted — known bypass, documenting behavior

name: env-override-lower
upstream_reason: SHUNT_MIN_LINES=200 overrides default — 250-line file should block

name: env-override-higher
upstream_reason: SHUNT_MIN_LINES=500 overrides default — 351-line file should be allowed

name: env-non-numeric-fallback
upstream_reason: Non-numeric SHUNT_MIN_LINES falls back to 350 — 351-line file blocked
